content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 51 vacancies are available - 6 for Anaesthesiology & Critical Care, 2 for Anatomy, 3 for Biochemistry, 2 for Community Medicine & Family Medicine, 1 for Dentistry (Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopedics), 1 for Dentistry (Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery), 4 for Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology, 3 for General Medicine, 4 for General Surgery, 1 for Hospital Administration, 1 for Microbiology, 4 for Nuclear Medicine, 2 for Obstetrics & Gynaecology, 1 for Ophthalmology, 3 for Orthopaedics, 1 for Paediatrics, 2 for Pathology & Lab Medicine, 3 for Pharmacology, 1 for Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation, 1 for Physiology, 3 for Radiation Oncology/ Radio Therapy, and 2 for Transfusion Medicine.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Jodhpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Senior Resident posts at AIIMS Jodhpur is 05-10-2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 51 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident positions across various departments at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is MD/DNB/MS/MDS/PhD as per the specific department's requirements. Please refer to the detailed notification for department-specific qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to these posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 1000. SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 800, and PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for AIIMS Jodhpur Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an MCQ based Written Examination followed by an Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,700 per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Senior Resident posts are on a contractual basis. Details regarding the contract period are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The direct link to download the official notification PDF is provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the provided 'Apply Online' link before the last date, 05-10-2026.
